bloodlines.arcana: Increase by 4 the DC to dispel transmutation or conjuration (creation) spells you cast.

powers.name: Protoplasm
powers.summary: Hurl entropic protoplasm within 30 feet as a tanglefoot bag that also deals 1 acid damage each round while the target is entangled. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Protean Resistances
powers.summary: Gain acid resistance 5 and +2 on saves against polymorph, petrification, and transmutation; at 9th level these improve to acid resistance 10 and +4.

powers.name: Reality Wrinkle
powers.summary: Create a mobile 10-foot mutable-reality aura that slows others as solid fog and gives attacks entering it a 20% miss chance, for rounds per day equal to your sorcerer level.

powers.name: Spatial Tear
powers.summary: Once per day use dimension door while leaving black tentacles at your former location; at 20th level use this twice per day.

powers.name: Avatar of Chaos
powers.summary: Gain immunity to acid, petrification, and unwanted polymorph effects, plus +2 to spell save DCs and spell penetration checks against lawful creatures.

bloodlines.arcana: Your mind-affecting and language-dependent spells affect animals, magical beasts, and monstrous humanoids as humanoids that understand your language.

powers.name: Serpent's Fang
powers.summary: Grow a venomous bite natural weapon for rounds per day equal to 3 + Charisma modifier; its poison and ability to overcome damage reduction improve with level.

powers.name: Serpentfriend
powers.summary: Speak at will with reptilian animals and gain a viper familiar using your sorcerer level minus 2 as your effective wizard level.

powers.name: Snakeskin
powers.summary: Gain +1 natural armor, +2 racial saves against poison, and +2 Escape Artist; all three bonuses increase by 1 at levels 13 and 17.

powers.name: Den of Vipers
powers.summary: Once per day summon serpent swarms as creeping doom whose poison deals Constitution damage and that entangle other creatures sharing their space.

powers.name: Scaled Soul
powers.summary: Gain the shapechanger subtype, assume reptilian humanoid or snake forms at will, become immune to poison and paralysis, and use Serpent's Fang without limit.
